import argparse

from tinytasks.api import (
    clear_overdue, create_task, delete_task, get_overdue_tasks, remove_tasks, rename_task,
)
from tinytasks.text import normalize_title


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tinytasks")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add")
    p_add.add_argument("title")
    p_add.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    sub.add_parser("overdue")
    sub.add_parser("clear-overdue")

    p_quick = sub.add_parser("quick-add")
    p_quick.add_argument("title")

    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete")
    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)

    p_rm = sub.add_parser("rm")
    p_rm.add_argument("ids", type=int, nargs="+", metavar="ID")

    p_ren = sub.add_parser("rename")
    p_ren.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_ren.add_argument("new_title")

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "clear-overdue":
        print(clear_overdue())
    elif a.cmd == "quick-add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), 24 * 60 * 60)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "rm":
        print(remove_tasks(a.ids))
    elif a.cmd == "rename":
        ok = rename_task(a.id, normalize_title(a.new_title))
        print("renamed" if ok else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now and not t.archived]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def clear_overdue(now: float | None = None) -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) all overdue tasks; return how many were archived."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    tasks = load_all()
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if t.due_at < now and not t.archived:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Soft-delete: mark the task archived and keep its record."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False


def remove_tasks(ids: list[int]) -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) every non-archived task whose id is in `ids`; return how many."""
    wanted = set(ids)
    tasks = load_all()
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id in wanted and not t.archived:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def rename_task(task_id: int, new_title: str) -> bool:
    """Change a task's title; return False if no such task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.title = new_title
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False

import sys

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import create_task, remove_tasks, rename_task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def test_remove_tasks_archives_given_ids(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", 60)
    b = create_task("b", 60)
    c = create_task("c", 60)
    assert remove_tasks([a.id, c.id, 999]) == 2
    assert [(t.title, t.archived) for t in load_all()] == [
        ("a", True), ("b", False), ("c", True)]
    assert remove_tasks([a.id]) == 0


def test_rename_task(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", 60)
    assert rename_task(t.id, "new") is True
    assert load_all()[0].title == "new"
    assert rename_task(999, "x") is False


def test_cli_rm_and_rename(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", 60)
    b = create_task("b", 60)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "rm", str(a.id), str(b.id)])
    cli.main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "2"
    assert all(t.archived for t in load_all())
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "rename", str(a.id), "  new   name "])
    cli.main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "renamed"
    assert load_all()[0].title == "new name"

"""Text helpers."""

MAX_TITLE_LEN = 80


def normalize_title(title: str) -> str:
    """Strip, collapse whitespace runs to one space, truncate to 80 characters."""
    return " ".join(title.split())[:MAX_TITLE_LEN]

            keep[t.title] = t
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if not t.archived and keep[t.title] is not t:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:

    return count

            tasks.append(new)
            save_all(tasks)
            return new
    return None

import sys

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import copy_task, create_task, dedupe_tasks
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def test_dedupe_keeps_earliest_due_and_archives_rest(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    late = create_task("x", 300)
    early = create_task("x", 100)
    mid = create_task("x", 200)
    other = create_task("y", 50)
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 2
    state = {t.id: t.archived for t in load_all()}
    assert state == {late.id: True, early.id: False, mid.id: True, other.id: False}
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 0


def test_copy_task(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("orig", 60)
    c = copy_task(t.id, "orig (copy)")
    assert (c.title, c.due_at) == ("orig (copy)", t.due_at)
    assert len(load_all()) == 2
    assert copy_task(999, "x") is None


def test_cli_dedupe_and_copy(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("same", 100)
    create_task("same", 200)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "dedupe"])
    cli.main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "1"
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "copy", str(a.id)])
    cli.main()
    assert "same (copy)" in capsys.readouterr().out
    assert load_all()[-1].due_at == a.due_at
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "copy", "999"])
    cli.main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "no such task"


def test_cli_copy_long_title_keeps_suffix(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("z" * 80, 60)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "copy", str(t.id)])
    cli.main()
    new = load_all()[-1].title
    assert len(new) <= 80 and new.endswith(" (copy)")

- **`dedupe`:** Among active tasks with exactly the same title, it keeps the one with the earliest `due_at` and archives the rest. If due dates tie, it keeps the lowest id. It prints how many tasks it archived.
